review_text: Dropped in here on Thursday around 10 and just a couple students were in there dining. It’s across from a university campus so I would imagine most of the patrons are students. It’s a busy area and busy street. I ordered an iced Spanish Latte since another reviewer raved about it. It was good and priced appropriately. The place was clean and the barista was polite.
A small cafe that has lots of food/snack options. Their food tasted good and the price is just on the right amount for its serving size.

Bad customer service. We went there yesterday with my classmates because we were running out of time on an essay activity that had just been posted earlier that day and the deadline was the same night. We decided to stop by their cafe to work on it together, thinking it would be a good place to stay. After almost an hour of staying there, the lights in our area were suddenly turned off by the staff. We felt very uncomfortable and insulted by this treatment.

Bad customer service. We went yesterday with my friends. It was okay at first, we drink our order while studying. Then it was almost an hour when their staff turned off the light in our area, we are very insulted by what happened.
The barista deserves a raise! I’m a coffeeholic and can vouch their iced Spanish Latte is one of the bests in the city. Smooth and lingering.
Excellent service! Coffee while you wait. I will definitely recommend and come back.
